card.title: M36 JACKSON
card.text: If the enemy discards M36 JACKSON from your hand, put it on the battlefield instead.
card.flavorText: The M36 Jackson, formally known as 90 mm Gun Motor Carriage, M36, was an American tank destroyer used by US forces during WWII. The M36 combined the hull of the M10 tank destroyer, which had a M4 Sherman's chassis, and a new turret mounting a 90 mm gun M3. It was designed in 1943 and first served in combat in October 1944, as a replacement for the M10 tank destroyer. The M36 had a crew of 5 (Commander, gunner, loader, driver, assistant driver) and a secondary armament of .50 caliber (12.7 mm) Browning M2HB machine gun. The M36 was well liked by US troops as it was one of the few armored vehicles available to the US forces that was capable of destroying heavy German tanks from a distance. It was generally referred to by American soldiers as "TD" (Tank Destroyer).
